manifest.name: Auto-Save Indicator
manifest.author: CardSpoke Community
manifest.description: Displays a live save status badge that tracks card save operations with debounced state transitions

css: .save-indicator { position: fixed; top: 10px; right: 10px; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 16px; font-size: 11px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; z-index: 9999; transition: all 0.4s ease; pointer-events: none; } .save-indicator.saved { background: rgba(46,204,113,0.15); color: #27ae60; border: 1px solid rgba(46,204,113,0.3); } .save-indicator.saving { background: rgba(52,152,219,0.15); color: #2980b9; border: 1px solid rgba(52,152,219,0.3); } .save-indicator.error { background: rgba(231,76,60,0.15); color: #c0392b; border: 1px solid rgba(231,76,60,0.3); } .save-indicator.idle { background: rgba(149,165,166,0.1); color: #95a5a6; border: 1px solid rgba(149,165,166,0.2); } @keyframes save-pulse { 0% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.5; } 100% { opacity: 1; } } .save-indicator.saving { animation: save-pulse 1s ease-in-out infinite; } body.dark-theme .save-indicator.saved { background: rgba(46,204,113,0.2); } body.dark-theme .save-indicator.idle { background: rgba(149,165,166,0.15); color: #bbb; }
